metrics.definition: Active subscribers at period end (confirmed, not unsubscribed, not bounced-hard).
Substack open rate: opens recorded in the Substack app and tracked email opens divided by delivered, per Substack's own attribution (third distinct population — do not blend).
Substack click rate: unique link clicks divided by delivered.

source: fixture — shaped like the official Substack MCP read-only analytics (Bestseller-admin gated live; fixture here)
